G1_formation.source: participant-model actual configured SDK, S0 only
G1_formation.instruction: Read the unchanged G0 proposal procedure, common H0 and the mechanically projected fixed public history packet (the complete original stays host-only and hash-bound). Propose one prospective change only to the natural-language proposal_procedure used to generate future H methods, with a hypothesis and falsifier, or return no-update. You cannot submit an H method or a D design in this role. You cannot change H0, tasks, evaluator, selection rule, budgets, tools, model, source access, or history. The same procedure will be frozen once and used in three independent fresh descendant lineage slots. The formation event is shared, not three independent trainings. Preserve errors and costs; no replacement attempt.

final_exposure: S0 exposes final task inputs only after all six arm/lineage H selections are frozen. Neither history nor G/H formation nor selection consumes final inputs/results or O0.
failure_policy: Retain invalid/no-update/failed/censored and costs, no replacement/rescue. If no admitted H descendant, select an explicitly labelled unchanged H0 fallback. G1 no-update/invalid does not become a claimed G change. S0 preserves the registered finite slots and original failure.
freshness_and_parity: Each H proposal is fresh from identical H0/history, never sequential sibling editing. Every D starts fresh at task entry with same complete information, tools, model, cache snapshot and caps; exact-input cache hits do not reuse Agent decisions or expand logical D budget. No G/H proposal role may check or submit D.
cost_boundary: All actual requests/wall/USD, including failed/no-update proposals, unselected siblings, selection and final confirmations, are charged. G1 actual shared formation is allocated once across its three arms by floor-plus-first-remainders for requests and exact conserved decimal thirds for wall/USD. H0 controls are common separately budgeted once, not copied into each G arm. G0 proposal/design/selection/failure costs are not omitted. Assistance remains nonzero unpriced; estimates are not invoices.
provider_dispatch_authority: S0 only after source/split/usage/model/storage/slot gates; A preparation never calls the SDK
participant_history_abi: model_history_packet() or canonical model_history_packet_bytes(), identical for all G0/G1 formation and descendant prompts. Complete 257661-byte public_history_packet() is host audit only, never a G/H tool response.
